retestMethod: The ten first-pass exceptions were retested on the final build. The other 100 requests retain their first-pass evidence. Every changed outcome retains the initial result. Browser capture is not certified on these 100 sites.
speedFollowup: The four failed cases were retested on the optimized transfer engine and all passed with SHA256 matches. The final build additionally wakes the UI immediately for new requests. Other cases retain their prior evidence; all 110 cases were not rerun after optimization.

performance.method: 32 MiB HTTP/1.1 fixture, 25ms per connection setup and 15ms per request, three repeats each, full SHA256 integrity. Simulated latency; not an internet speed guarantee.
performance.scope: Performance was measured on the optimized engine before the final UI wake change. The benchmark is a controlled latency fixture, not a guarantee for public websites.
